card.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of AI-powered vehicle inspection systems, combining computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI.

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, JLR, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is deployed across manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, fleets, and seaports worldwide. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2026, our 270+ global employees are solutions-oriented, accountable, and driven by one shared goal: making roads safer for everyone.

We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Global Supply Chain to lead the strategy and execution of our end-to-end global supply chain, including procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier management, inventory planning, logistics, and warehouse operations. This executive will build scalable capabilities that support company growth, successful installations, and reliable field service across multiple geographies, with accountability for delivery performance, cost, working capital, and supply continuity.

This role requires a strategic, hands-on leader who can set long-term direction while working directly with teams and suppliers to negotiate critical agreements, resolve material constraints, and improve operational performance. Partnering closely with the COO and executive leadership team, the VP will align supply chain priorities with business objectives, strengthen planning and operational visibility, and develop a high-performing organization with clear ownership and measurable results.

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

* Set the global supply chain strategy. Develop and execute a multiyear roadmap aligned with growth plans, installation requirements, service commitments, and financial objectives.
* Own operational and financial performance. Establish accountability for total supply chain cost, inventory investment, delivery reliability, and warehouse productivity. Partner with Finance to develop budgets, evaluate investments, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Connect business demand with supply execution. Establish a cross-functional planning cadence that aligns forecasts, installation schedules, field service requirements, supplier capacity, and inventory availability. Surface constraints early and drive decisions that protect customer commitments.
* Lead strategic sourcing and supplier performance. Develop sourcing strategies, negotiate commercial agreements, and build supplier relationships that improve cost, quality, lead times, and capacity. Hold suppliers accountable through clear expectations and performance reviews.
* Build supply resilience. Identify critical dependencies and develop mitigation plans for supplier disruption, capacity constraints, long lead times, and cross-border risks.
* Optimize inventory and material availability. Establish inventory policies that balance installation and service readiness with working capital discipline, reducing shortages, excess stock, and obsolescence.
* Direct global logistics and warehouse operations. Design scalable distribution capabilities and oversee freight, import/export, fulfillment, and material flow to installation sites and field teams. Ensure safe, accurate, compliant, and efficient operations.
* Strengthen systems, data, and decision-making. Set standards for ERP data integrity, inventory visibility, and reporting. Prioritize improvements in systems and automation that support scale and better operational decisions.
* Build and develop the organization. Define the team structure, hire and develop strong leaders, establish succession plans, and create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as an executive business partner. Present performance, risks, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations to senior leadership. Align stakeholders around decisions that improve customer outcomes and support sustainable growth.

 
Requirements:
 

* 15+ years of progressive supply chain experience, including at least 7 years in senior leadership roles overseeing multidisciplinary teams across multiple geographies. Demonstrated accountability for enterprise supply chain strategy, financial performance, and organizational development is required; prior VP-level or equivalent executive leadership experience is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* A hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to set strategic direction while directly engaging in critical supplier negotiations, resolving material shortages, improving warehouse and logistics processes, and supporting installation and field service readiness.
* Experience leading complex supply chains across multiple geographies, including procurement, supplier management, inventory, logistics, and warehouse operations.
* A track record of scaling operations and delivering measurable improvements in cost, delivery performance, inventory efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget ownership, working capital management, supplier negotiations, and investment evaluation.
* Experience establishing cross-functional planning processes that align demand, supply, and operational execution.
* Working knowledge of international trade, import/export compliance, and cross-border logistics.
* Experience using ERP systems and operational analytics to improve visibility, controls, and performance, with the ability to work directly with data to diagnose issues and drive corrective action; NetSuite experience is preferred.
* Ability to influence executive stakeholders, make decisions amid uncertainty, and translate strategy into clear priorities and accountable execution.
* Ability to develop strong leaders, delegate effectively, and build team capability while remaining actively engaged in operational performance.
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15% to support installation sites, operational locations, and supplier visits, including locations in Indiana, Canada, and Mexico.

Ideally, we’re looking for:

* VP / Director-level or equivalent leadership experience in a high-growth business with complex installation, deployment, or field service requirements.
* Experience supporting both project-based material demand and ongoing service or spare-parts needs.
* Success transforming a supply chain organization through direct involvement in process improvements, stronger planning, leadership development, and systems implementation.
* Experience expanding supplier and distribution capabilities into new geographies.
* A strategic, hands-on leader who is comfortable working alongside teams in warehouses, at installation sites, and with suppliers to understand challenges, remove barriers, and deliver results.

Benefits we offer:

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, company-paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

Compensation:

UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $250,000 – $280,000.

Physical Requirements & Travel:

This role may involve on-site or field-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

Why UVeye

 

* Tech-First Mindset: Join a team at the forefront of innovation, where cutting-edge technology is shaping the future of AI and redefining the automotive industry.
* Industry Leadership: Be part of a trailblazing company driving real change—backed by rapid growth, a track record of success, and strong partnerships with global industry leaders.
* People-Centered Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive environment that values initiative, supports growth, and provides unique opportunities for development through executive workshops and mentorship programs.

UVeye is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

card.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Eldridge, IA – Direct Hire**

**Full time – On Site**

Productive Resources (www.productiveresources.com) is seeking a candidate to be part of our engineering team for our customer's facility in Eldridge, IA. As a member of our team, the selected candidate will be a Director of Quality who provides strategic and hands-on leadership for quality operations and is responsible for the planning, organization, direction, coordination, compliance, and control of the Company's Quality Management System. This role leads the Quality team and ensures the effectiveness of quality processes across the organization, including product and process quality, supplier quality, inspection activities, corrective actions, audit readiness, customer quality performance, and compliance with all applicable contractual, regulatory, and government requirements.

The Director of Quality is responsible for developing and leading employees, strengthening accountability, and partnering with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Executive Leadership to prevent defects, drive continuous improvement, and support the safe, compliant, and on-time delivery of mission-critical products. This position oversees departmental personnel and processes, providing coaching, direction, and support to ensure the safe and efficient execution of work while maintaining quality standards, meeting customer requirements, and effectively managing operational costs. Through strong leadership and oversight, the Director of Quality ensures quality objectives are achieved and organizational performance continuously improves.

This is a full-time position that is indefinite in duration with the opportunity of professional growth, and additional opportunities within our organization.

**Duties:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Quality managers, engineers, inspectors, supplier quality personnel, and other assigned team members.
* Establish and execute a quality strategy aligned with Company goals, customer expectations, contractual requirements, and operational priorities.
* Maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System and ensure processes remain effective, documented, implemented, and audit-ready.
* Lead internal, external, customer, registrar, and government audits; ensure findings are contained, corrected, and closed with effective corrective action.
* Own quality performance metrics and executive reporting, including product conformity, customer complaints, supplier quality, corrective action, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, and audit performance.
* Drive disciplined nonconformance control, material review, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing and Engineering to improve process capability, inspection planning, product acceptance methods, error prevention, and manufacturability.
* Oversee inspection and test activities, measurement-system controls, calibration coordination, and the integrity and retention of quality records.
* Lead supplier quality strategy, qualification, surveillance, performance review, development, and supplier corrective action.
* Ensure customer-specific, contractual, regulatory, and government quality requirements are identified, flowed down, implemented, and maintained.
* Support first article inspections, source inspections, customer returns, complaint investigations, configuration and change-control activities, and product or process validation as required.
* Build a quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, objective evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop departmental staffing, training, succession, budget, and resource plans necessary to support current operations and future growth.
* Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and executive leadership to resolve systemic issues and meet Company objectives.
* Any other duties assigned by Vice President of Operations.
 

 

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Operations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience managing quality functions and teams within a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading a multi-functional quality organization, including Quality Engineering, Inspection, Supplier Quality, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Internal Audits, and Regulatory/Customer Compliance activities.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality processes and standards.
* Experience with ISO 9001:2015 requirements, including coordinating and conducting internal audits and maintaining audit readiness.
* Proven ability to lead teams, develop talent, drive accountability, and collaborate cross-functionally to achieve quality and operational objectives.
* Strong working knowledge of NADCAP accreditation, its QMS, and quality requirements related to the special processes within Chemical Processing and Non-destructive Testing.
* Experience leading internal, customer, registrar, and government audits and responding effectively to findings.
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methods such as 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, A3, and DMAIC.
* Working knowledge of statistical process control, process capability, measurement systems, control plans, and risk-based quality planning.
* Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, supplier corrective action, and supplier development.
* Familiarity with government contracting and customer quality requirements, including FAR/DFARS and DCMA oversight, is preferred.
* Ability to translate quality data into clear priorities, executive-level metrics, and sustainable improvements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with direct engagement on the manufacturing floor and timely resolution of customer or production issues.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt are preferred.
* Must have good written and verbal communication skills while being able to motivate and manage reporting personnel, collaboration with peers, and report up to executive leadership as needed.
* Must be able to professionally coach and direct activities of a diverse team while being fair and consistent.
 

 

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* ISO Auditor Certification, Lean Six Sigma Certification, or other relevant quality management certifications.
* Experience in defense, government contracting, firearms, ammunition, aerospace, weapons systems, or another highly regulated precision manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of first article inspection, including AS9102.
 

 

**Compensation & Benefits:**

We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and excellent growth opportunities.

If you are the right person, if you have the expertise we need, submit your resume now!

card.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.

Overview:

**East Tennessee Behavioral Health** is seeking a dynamic and experienced **Director of Quality and Accreditation** to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

**East Tennessee Behavioral Healt**h is a 90-bed inpatient treatment center serving Knoxville, Tennessee, and the surrounding communities. We provide the highest-quality care for people who have mental health concerns such as depression, anxiety disorders, and bipolar disorder and those who have co-occurring addictions. The acute inpatient treatment we offer supports adolescents, adults, and senior adults, while our outpatient programming serves adults age 18 and older.

**East TN Behavioral Health Hospital** offers an extensive array of benefits to our valued team members. Current offerings encompass:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Company-paid Basic Life & AD&D insurance
* Disability benefits
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with a company match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Discount Program
* Paid Holidays for work-life balance
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement opportunities for career advancement

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
* QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.
 + Utilize collected data regarding the outcome of activities for delivering continuously improving services.
 + Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.
 + Complete process improvement projects and incorporate the results into patient care improvements.
 + Submit quality scorecard data to Acadia corporate office as requested.
 + Coordinate the abstraction of clinical data according to Joint Commission specifications and data entry via vendor database for Inpatient Psychiatric Core Measures (ex. national quality measures such as HBIPS).
 + Identify key aspects of care relevant indicators and evaluation of data using formal and informal feedback from consumers of services and other collateral sources is aggregated and used to improve management strategies and service delivery practices.
 + Lead/coordinate data collection and analysis from all departments within the facility.
 + Prepare and present program data trends and action plans to the monthly Quality Council and quarterly to the Medical Executive Committee and the Governing Board.
* Regulatory preparedness – implement sustainable survey preparation and ongoing monitoring processes, including facility-wide auditing and early-issue identification, to maximize achievement of zero- or standard-level survey outcomes.
 + Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
 + Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
 - Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
 - Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
 - Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
 + Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
 + Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
 + Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
 + Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
 + Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
 + Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
 + Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
 + Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
 + Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.

* Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
* + Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.
 + Translate standards, requirements, and policies into terms or processes meaningful to the facility.
* Leadership – serve as a visible, engaged, and dynamic member of the facility leadership team.
 + Chairs the monthly Quality Council
 + Complete safety rounds, participate in leadership rounding, and submit results/corrective actions to Acadia corporate office.
 + Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions.
 + Lead and facilitate Root Cause Analyses into all serious and/or sentinel events.
 + Invest in the facility staff through engagement in hiring, development, training, performance management, and communication to ensure effective and efficient operations.
 + Oversees the Culture of Safety Survey and follow-up action planning and sustainment processes.
 + Identification of problems or potential problems to prevent risks to patients and staff. Proposes corrective steps that may include, but are not limited to:
 - Changes in policies/procedures,
 - Staffing and assignment changes,
 - Additional education or training for staff,
 - Addition or deletion of services

**OTHER FUNCTIONS:**

* Perform other functions and tasks as assigned.

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Human Services or nursing required. Master’s degree in behavioral health/risk discipline, Registered Nurse preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in a Quality, Clinical, or PI role required.
* One or more years of management experience preferred.
* Experience with CARF, DEA, Joint Commission, or CMS surveys, as required by service line(s) supported

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Current licensure appropriate for the degree held required.
* CPR and de-escalation/restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility.

**ADDITIONAL REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS:**

***While this job description is intended to be*** ***an accurate*** ***reflection of the requirements of the job, management reserves the right to add or remove duties from*** ***par******ticular jobs*** ***when circumstances*** 
***(******e.g.*** ***emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs or technological developments) dictate.***

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment regardless of an individual’s characteristics protected by applicable state, federal and local laws.

card.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

card.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
 
 
**Job Description**

**EXAMPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Set the global Digital Quality strategy and roadmap**
 + Define the target state, strategic themes, capability model, and multi-year roadmap for Digital Quality.
 + Maintain a portfolio of initiatives aligned with Quality objectives, regulatory priorities, enterprise architecture, and available investment.
 + Establish measurable outcomes, including compliance effectiveness, cycle-time reduction, right-first-time performance, user adoption, data quality, and realized benefits.
* **Lead end-to-end Quality process mapping and optimization**
 + Map current- and future-state processes across sites, regions, and GxP domains, including roles, decisions, controls, systems, data, handoffs, pain points, and performance measures.
 + Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, digitize, automate, or retire processes before selecting technology.
 + Maintain process, capability, system, and data maps to support investment decisions, integration planning, and global standardization.
 + Partner with process owners to define requirements, target operating models, controls, and adoption plans.
* **Assess and recommend new digital tools**
 + Establish a consistent intake and assessment method for digital tools, platforms, automation, analytics, and AI use cases.
 + Evaluate intended use, user need, business value, GxP impact, patient and product risk, data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, interoperability, accessibility, scalability, supplier maturity, total cost, and support model.
 + Lead market scans, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, supplier due diligence, and fit-gap assessments.
 + Recommend whether to adopt, configure, integrate, scale, defer, or reject proposed solutions based on documented evidence.
 + Prevent technology-led implementations by confirming that each tool addresses a defined process need and has measurable success criteria.
* **Establish Digital Quality governance and assurance**
 + Define decision rights, design principles, architecture guardrails, stage gates, risk criteria, and governance forums for the Digital Quality portfolio.
 + Apply risk-based lifecycle assurance based on intended use and process risk, including requirements, supplier evidence, testing, traceability, release, change control, periodic review, and retirement.
 + Set governance for AI-enabled Quality solutions, including approved use cases, human oversight, data provenance, model performance, explainability, monitoring, drift, retraining, and accountability for decisions.
 + Ensure electronic records, signatures, audit trails, integrations, master data, and reporting controls meet applicable regulatory and company expectations.
* **Drive implementation, adoption, and value realization**
 + Provide Quality leadership through product selection, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
 + Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, training, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement across global functions and sites.
 + Monitor solution performance, incidents, compliance signals, user feedback, benefits, and emerging risks throughout the lifecycle.
 + Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, budgets, resource needs, suppliers, and executive reporting.
* **Develop organizational capability**
 + Build digital literacy, process-mapping capability, product-management practices, and risk-based assurance skills across Quality.
 + Lead and develop internal staff and cross-functional teams; engage external specialists when needed.
 + Represent Quality in enterprise digital, data, AI, architecture, cybersecurity, and investment forums.
 + Monitor evolving regulations, industry practices, and emerging technologies and translate them into practical Quality standards and roadmaps.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Please see the following for the qualifications and skills we seek for this role.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in Digital Quality, Quality systems, digital transformation, computer system assurance or validation, process excellence, product management, or a related discipline.
* Experience in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, or another highly regulated life-sciences environment.
* Demonstrated experience defining strategy and delivering global digital programs across multiple functions, sites, or regions.
* Hands-on experience with process mapping, value-stream analysis, requirements definition, fit-gap assessment, and future-state design.
* Experience assessing and implementing digital platforms, SaaS solutions, workflow automation, analytics, data products, or AI-enabled tools.
* Knowledge of risk-based computer software assurance, computerized system validation, electronic records and signatures, data integrity, supplier assurance, and system lifecycle management.
* Experience establishing governance, prioritizing portfolios, preparing business cases, managing budgets, and measuring benefits.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, change-management, project, product, and vendor-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and lead multidisciplinary teams without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise recommendations and decision materials.
* Ability to travel as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Quality, life sciences, engineering, information systems, business, data science, or a related discipline.
* Experience leading an enterprise Digital Quality strategy, capability model, or multi-year transformation roadmap.
* Experience with electronic quality management, document and learning management, laboratory, manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, analytics, integration, or collaboration platforms.
* Experience conducting market scans, supplier due diligence, proofs of concept, pilots, and formal digital-tool evaluations.
* Experience applying product-management, enterprise-architecture, data-governance, or organizational change-management practices.
* Experience establishing governance for artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of cloud services, cybersecurity, privacy, integration patterns, master data, metadata, and third-party risk.
* Experience rationalizing application portfolios and supporting global process and technology standardization.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Expert understanding of global GxP Quality processes and the drug-development and product lifecycle, with the ability to connect process, data, technology, and control requirements.
* Strong knowledge of digital Quality platforms and how they support regulated business processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning risks and controls, including intended-use definition, human oversight, data provenance, performance criteria, monitoring, drift, change, and retraining governance.
* Ability to distinguish business criticality, GxP impact, and process risk and translate the assessment into proportionate assurance activities.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements, process maps, user requirements, evaluation criteria, roadmaps, and investment recommendations.
* Strong facilitation, critical-thinking, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to communicate direction, trade-offs, risks, status, and value to executives, steering committees, process owners, technical teams, and end users.

Commitment to global standardization while accommodating justified regional or functional requirements.

card.description:
**Join the Clean Energy Revolution**

 

Become a **Senior Manager, Demand Side Management Quality Assurance & Engineering** at Southern California Edison (SCE) and build a better tomorrow. In this role, you’ll lead a regulatory (policy) engineering team that conducts technical reviews, researches and develops new technologies, and works closely with the CPUC and industry experts to advance energy efficiency. Because you’ll oversee the quality control of program implementations and ensure their compliance, ideally your background would include Demand Side Management (DSM), such as Energy Efficiency, Demand Response, Integrated Demand Side Management, and Distributed Energy Resources.

 

As a **Senior Manager, Demand Side Management Quality Assurance & Engineering**, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future?

 

**Incident Management Team Expected Participation**: Employees are expected to support emergency response and/or business continuity efforts, including readiness to serve on an Incident Management Team (IMT) when needed. Employees will participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every four to six weeks), to support IMT activations during emergency events. IMT assignments may differ from an individual’s regular responsibilities.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Leads a variety of engineering and business initiatives to develop grid strategies, determine how the grid is planned, designed, operated and maintained to operationalize company's strategy
* Manages and prioritizes the engineering roadmap in collaboration with other departments; develops and implements strategies for improving execution efficiency
* Leads, manages and supports the project engineering group and remains responsible and accountable for their team's delivery of small to large scale projects
* Manages execution performance of their teams, identifying barriers, and prioritizing work for their teams to ensure projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budgets
* Reviews and makes decisions on project plans, resource allocation, risk assessment, mitigation strategies, budgets, and resources to ensure timely and successful delivery of capital and strategic projects Oversee the development and implementation of a comprehensive project management framework to ensure efficient project execution, reporting, and delivery of goals within budget
* Drives the adoption of digitalization and automation technologies to improve engineering processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance project outcomes
* Leads the development and maintains a robust risk management strategy to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with engineering projects
* Develops goals and assigns projects/roles to employees that translate corporate strategic vision into actionable initiatives to delegate.
* Leads the development and implementation of cross organizational strategy, technology and safety program to ensure company advancement toward future vision and the well-being of employees and contractors involved in engineering projects
* A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Five or more years of experience supervising a team of direct reports and/or project management.
* Experience performing engineering work in operations, production, construction or maintenance environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in business administration, engineering (mechanical, electrical, or environmental), or a related scientific or technical field.
* Five or more years of experience managing an organization and/or complex DSM policy and regulatory projects involving multiple stakeholders, including the CPUC.
* Three or more years of experience leading engineering or technical projects.
* Three or more years of experience managing vendors and coordinating with technical staff and consultants.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach to problem-solving.
* Experience with DSM programs, including Energy Efficiency, Demand Response, Integrated Demand Side Management, or Distributed Energy Resources.

 

**Additional Information**

 

* This position’s work mode is **hybrid.** The employee will report to an SCE facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days. Unless otherwise noted, employees are required to work and reside in the state of California. Further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. The work mode can be changed based on business needs.
* Visit our Candidate Resource page to get meaningful information related to benefits, perks, resources, testing information, hiring process, and more!
* Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.
* Position will require up to 10% traveling and being out in the field throughout the SCE service territory.
* Relocation does not apply to this position.

 

**About Southern California Edison**

 

The people at SCE don't just keep the lights on. Our mission is so much bigger. We’re fueling the kind of innovation that’s changing an entire industry, and quite possibly the planet. Join us and create a future with cleaner energy, while providing our customers with the safety and reliability they demand. At SCE, you’ll have a chance to grow personally and professionally, making a real impact in Southern California and around the world.

 

Southern California Edison is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

 

We are committed to ensuring that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations at AskHR@sce.com or (626) 302-3456 and select option 2.

card.title: Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Senior Manager
card.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The **Senior Manager, Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA)**, is responsible for leading and continuously improving all food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality management programs within a food manufacturing facility. This role ensures compliance with federal, state, customer, and third-party requirements, including Safe Quality Food (SQF) standards, while driving a culture of food safety, quality excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.

As the site’s food safety and quality leader, the Senior Manager provides strategic oversight of food safety systems, audit readiness, risk management, and quality performance. Working cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, and Product Development teams, this position ensures the consistent production of safe, high-quality products from raw materials through finished goods.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the site's quality management systems, overseeing quality control activities across raw materials, in-process production, and finished products.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, and Commercial teams.
* Provide strategic oversight of product traceability, stock recovery, recall readiness, and crisis management programs.
* Establish, interpret, and continuously improve Quality Assurance and Quality Control standards, procedures, KPIs, SOPs, and GMP programs.

**Food Safety & Quality Program Leadership**

* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of food safety and quality programs, including SQF, HACCP, HARPC, and GMP systems.
* Maintain GFSI-recognized certifications, including SQF, ensuring ongoing audit readiness and compliance.
* Ensure all food safety, quality, and regulatory documentation, procedures, and records are accurate, current, and compliant.

**Team Leadership & Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the FSQA team, including talent acquisition, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Champion a strong food safety and quality culture by providing training and coaching to employees at all levels of the organization.

**Audit, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Serve as the primary lead for all regulatory, customer, and third-party audits, inspections, and certification activities.
* Direct internal audit programs and oversee corrective and preventive action plans to address non-conformances.
* Manage customer and consumer complaint programs, including root cause investigations and continuous improvement initiatives

**Regulatory & Customer Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory, customer, and certification requirements, including HACCP, FSMA, CFIA, FDA, GFSI, and SQF standards.
* Monitor emerging regulatory and industry developments and implement changes to maintain compliance and operational excellence.

**Supplier Quality Management**

* Oversee supplier approval and performance management programs to ensure all materials meet food safety and quality requirements.
* Lead supplier audits, risk assessments, and improvement initiatives to strengthen supply chain quality and compliance.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline required; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive Food Safety and Quality Assurance experience within a food manufacturing environment, including at least 3-5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading and maintaining SQF and other GFSI-recognized food safety systems within a complex manufacturing operation.
* Proven experience leading, developing, and coaching high-performing teams while building a strong food safety and quality culture.
* Strong knowledge of HACCP, HARPC, GMPs, FSMA, CFIA, FDA, GFSI, and SQF requirements and their practical application in food manufacturing.
* Experience leading regulatory, customer, and third-party audits, including successful management of corrective and preventive action programs.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and quality management systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence decision-making at all levels of the organization.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS**

* Expert knowledge of food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements, including FDA, CFIA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP, GFSI, and SQF standards.
* Strong understanding of food safety systems, risk assessment, hygienic zoning, sanitation, environmental monitoring, allergen management, and preventive controls.
* Proven ability to lead food safety and quality strategy within a manufacturing environment while driving a culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across all levels of the organization.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical capabilities, including expertise in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), trend analysis, and risk mitigation.
* Strong knowledge of quality management systems, data analysis, and performance metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
* Demonstrated project management and change management skills, with experience leading cross-functional initiatives and implementing sustainable process improvements.
* Strong customer and regulatory audit management experience, including interactions with customers, certification bodies, and regulatory agencies.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Must be comfortable working in a bakery manufacturing environment with exposure to elevated temperatures and production equipment.
* Frequent walking and standing throughout the production facility to conduct inspections, audits, observations, and support operational activities.
* Prolonged periods of standing, walking, and sitting may be required.
* Occasional lifting, carrying, or moving of product samples, ingredients, materials, or equipment up to 25-50 lbs.
* Manual dexterity required to operate testing equipment, utilize computer systems, document findings, and review records.
* Occasional bending, reaching, climbing, and accessing equipment or storage areas during inspections, audits, and investigations.
* Exposure to varying environmental conditions, including hot production areas, cool storage environments, and refrigerated spaces.
* Strong visual acuity required to identify product defects, verify compliance standards, and review documentation.
* Ability to use sensory evaluation techniques, including sight, smell, and taste, when assessing ingredients, products, and quality attributes.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

card.title: Director of Quality Management - Inpatient Rehab
card.description:
**Banner Rehabilitation Hospital - Tucson**
**Director of Quality Management**
**(DQM)**

* Bonus incentives
* Extensive onboarding and training program
* Customizable health insurance packages

**Who We Are**
Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas
 
 
Coordinates the Medical Quality Management and Performance Improvement activities to measurably enhance the quality, process and cost effectiveness of patient and customer services rendered. Coordinates the Performance Improvement and Patient Safety programs in accordance with the guidelines and regulatory requirements of Federal and State regulations on a hospital-wide basis. Oversees operations of the Infection Control and Employee Health Programs. Develops and Reviews policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all regulatory and accrediting standards. Collects data to monitor compliance and/or trends.
 
 

* Institutes and monitors the Hospital’s CQI Processes, utilizing data analysis measuring tools. Oversight/coordination of operations of the Infection Control & Employee Health Program based upon hospital size and configuration.
* Assists with the design and compliance of quality processes/activities in the areas of clinical/medical staff PI for all applicable clinical/medical TJC /CARF/DOH standards. Assists with all assigned activities to assure that the hospital maintains accreditation, certification and licensure. Assumes leadership with the Joint Commission and DOH as well as other regulatory agencies with regard to CQI activities.
* Serves as a resource for all departments within the facility to provide guidance on designing, implementing, analyzing and reporting on Quality Improvement.
* Assists clinical areas in developing criteria, monitoring and reporting mechanisms and action documentation related to the hospital’s CQI program.
* Performs basic chart review activities with appropriate staff for outcome utilization, infection control and medical CQI indicators. Analyzes results of chart review activities with appropriate staff and confers with department staff on any case requiring special attention.
* Prepares analysis of significant PI findings pertaining to adverse drug reactions, drug usage evaluation, medical management of acute transfers and other CQI indicators.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse with valid state license. Legacy employees may exist with other clinical licensure.
* Requires experience in at least one of the core areas of responsibility: Quality, Survey Readiness, Risk Management, Infection Control, Employee Health and Education
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including TJC and CARF preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience in Quality Improvement, with Statistical Process Control experience and computer skills preferred.
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including JCAHO and CARF preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) preferred

card.description:

**Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Accounts Payable:** Oversee invoice processing, approval workflows, vendor maintenance, payment runs, employee expense reimbursements, and issue resolution while ensuring payments are accurate, timely, properly authorized, and compliant with company policies.
* **Accounts Receivable:** Oversee customer invoicing, cash application, account reconciliation, collections, credit administration, dispute resolution, and aging review to support timely cash conversion and minimize past-due balances.
* **Travel Management:** Lead global adoption and upkeep of SAP Concur, manage global travel policy, partner with global travel management vendor, liaise with Treasury on credit card solutions and integrations to Concur and ERP, and reconcile related balance sheet balances and accruals.
* **Close and reconciliation:** Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and year-end close activities, including subledger reconciliations, accrual support, aging analysis, and resolution of reconciling items.
* **Controls and compliance:** Maintain strong internal controls, segregation of duties, and complete documentation; support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and company policies.
* **Cash flow and reporting:** Monitor payables and receivables trends, prepare cash requirement and collection forecasts, and provide accurate metrics and analysis to Finance leadership.
* **Process improvement:** Identify and implement opportunities to standardize, automate, and streamline processes; strengthen data quality, cycle time, scalability, and the stakeholder experience.
* **Systems and master data:** Support effective use of ERP, banking, expense, and workflow systems; maintain accurate vendor and customer master data and participate in system implementations or enhancements.
* **Business partnership:** Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, Treasury, Tax, and other partners to address root causes, resolve escalated issues, and improve end-to-end processes.
* **Risk management:** Implement controls that reduce fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorized transactions, bad debt, and credit exposure; escalate significant risks promptly.
* Develop, document, and maintain policies, procedures, service standards, and business continuity plans for both functions.
* Perform other responsibilities and special projects as assigned.

**Experience Requirements:**

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, accounting operations, or a related field, including at least three years of people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated knowledge of invoice-to-pay and order-to-cash processes, general ledger interfaces, reconciliations, month-end close, internal controls, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort using reporting and workflow tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions and with customers and vendors.
* High degree of accuracy, integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* CPA, CMA, CAPP, CICP, or other relevant professional certification preferred.
* Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency, manufacturing, life sciences, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Experience with shared services, system implementation, process automation, or continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Concur preferred.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:**

* Comfort with working at a computer for extended periods.

* Capacity to lift and carry up to [25–50] pounds as required

* Able to communicate effectively via phone, video, and written communication.

* Occasional need to move about the office to access meetings or resources.

**Why Work for Nova Biomedical**

* Flexible Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
* Competitive 401k company match
* Bonus Program, Generous PTO and paid holidays
* Generous Tuition reimbursement
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Professional development, engagement and events
* Company marketplace for lunch and snacks in our Norwood, MA, Billerica, MA and Westbrook, ME offices
* Company subsidized cafeteria in our Waltham, MA office

**Work Location:** Hybrid in **Waltham, MA**

**Targeted Salary Range:** **$180,000-$220,000/yr**

Nova Biomedical believes in transparency and integrity throughout all we do, including compensation. The provided salary range for this role represents the expected base salary or hourly rate for this opening. Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and may vary based on individual factors such as location, skills, and education.
 
 
About the company

At Nova Biomedical, we’re not just building instruments, we’re powering breakthroughs that improve lives. Our smart, science-driven solutions are trusted in over 100 countries to speed drug development and enhance patient care.

Our integration brings together more than 70 years of scientific excellence with Nova’s cutting-edge innovation, forming a powerhouse of precision, purpose, and possibility. With FDA-registered, ISO-certified manufacturing, more than 125 FDA approvals, and industry-trusted diagnostics, we’re setting new standards in quality and reliability. Nova Biomedical is proud to be a global leader in osmolality testing and biotechnology and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) instrumentation, dedicated to advancing patient care and scientific discovery with a legacy that continues to shape the future of life sciences.

With headquarters in Norwood and Waltham, Massachusetts, and a global team of nearly 2,000 employees, we’re building a collaborative, empowered culture grounded in shared values: Customer Centricity, Ingenuity, Ownership & Accountability, Collaboration, and Integrity.

Working at Nova Biomedical means joining a mission-driven organization where your contributions matter. Whether you're in engineering, science, manufacturing, or support, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, invests in your growth, and is committed to making a real-world impact on global health.

Explore what’s next with us at novabiomedical.com

card.description:
Who We Are
 
 
Chesapeake Employers’ Insurance Company is a purpose-driven organization dedicated to improving the lives and livelihoods of our policyholders, injured workers, team members, and the community. As a leading workers' compensation specialty insurer in the mid-Atlantic region, we take pride in being a force for good. Our 350 team members are committed to making a positive impact every day in the lives of all our stakeholders. Join our motivated, professional team as we foster a culture of values, teamwork, innovation, and collaboration. Established in 1914, Chesapeake Employers Insurance, headquartered in Towson, Maryland, has over a century of experience, a strong financial foundation, and an "A" rating from AM Best.
 
 
Why This Role Matters
 
This is a unique opportunity to join an organization as the leader responsible for shaping Chesapeake's operating model. This role sits at the center of how Chesapeake sustainably translates strategic and operational intent into focused action and impact.
 
At Chesapeake Employers, we believe great strategy only creates value when it is consistently translated into focused execution. We are seeking a Director of Strategic Operations to serve as the enterprise steward of Chesapeake's Growth System; our Four Disciplines of Execution-based (4DX) operating model.
 
Reporting directly to the President & CEO, this highly visible leadership role is responsible for owning, sustaining, and maturing Chesapeake’s operating model (The Growth System) enabling focused, enterprise-side strategic and operational execution. The Director of Strategic Operations will work closely with executive leaders and teams across the company to ensure priorities are clear, resources are aligned, and the organization's most important work moves forward.
 
This is an opportunity for a systems designer, disciplined operator, and influential leader who thrives on creating clarity, building alignment, and driving execution in a collaborative environment. This leader will influence not only what Chesapeake achieves, but how it achieves it; helping make the Growth System the Chesapeake Way of working.
 
What Success Looks Like
 
A successful Director of Strategic Operations will help Chesapeake mature a disciplined, sustainable operating system for execution. Over time, success in this role will look like:
 

* Maintaining Growth System Standard Operating Procedures: playbooks, templates, tools, processes and communication materials.
* Ensuring the Growth System is understood, consistently applied, and continuously improved across the enterprise.
* Supporting leaders’ understanding of how the elements of the Growth System work together within Chesapeake’s operating model.
* Guiding the senior leadership team to prioritize Strategic Execution Wildly Important Goals (WIGs) aligned to enterprise strategy and scope WIGs into executable programs and projects within the 4DX model.
* Orchestrating delivery across the Strategic Execution WIG portfolio.
* Coaching leaders on 4DX operating model disciplines, including WIG design, scoreboard development, team kickoffs and syncs, and celebration rituals.
* Supporting team leaders in identifying, creating a backlog, prioritizing, and launching Focused Improvement WIGs that deliver targeted, measurable growth and improvement outcomes.
* Designing, maturing and running Chesapeake’s Enterprise Project Portfolio Council (EPPC) and overarching governance model that supports Growth System WIG capacity assessment, prioritization decisioning and execution coordination.
* Helping leaders assess team capacity, authority, resources, and focus needed to execute WIGs successfully.
* Providing executive leaders with clear visibility into progress, blockers, and capacity concerns.
* Helping teams see how their work connects to Chesapeake’s purpose and strategy.
* The Growth System becomes a trusted way of working.

Be a Part of Inspiring Chesapeake’s Values-Based Leadership Mindset:
 
Purpose Driven
 
Connects goals, priorities, and execution to a larger mission and helps others understand the impact of their work.
 
People First
 
Builds trust, listens with curiosity, and helps teams navigate change with empathy and clarity.
 
Committed to Winning Together
 
Breaks down silos, fosters collaboration, and creates environments where teams succeed together.
 
A Risk Taker at Heart
 
Fosters curiosity, encourages experimentation and guides the organization to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.
 
Join us and shape how Chesapeake sustainably translates strategic and operational intent into focused action and impact.
 
 
**Position Summary:** 
The Director of Strategic Operations is an enterprise-wide systems design and execution leader responsible for owning, sustaining and maturing the company’s operating model. Chesapeake Employers’ Growth System is the company’s Four Disciplines of Execution (4DX)-based operating model enabling Strategic and Focused Improvement (operational-level) execution to continuously and sustainably grow stakeholder value.
 
This role sits at the center of how Chesapeake sustainably translates strategic and operational intent into focused action and impact. The Director of Strategic Operations ensures that Wildly Important Goals (WIGs) are well-formed, appropriately prioritized and resourced, actively managed, and connected to the company’s strategic direction, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and annual business plan. They ensure the Growth System is not treated as an additional layer of work but becomes The Chesapeake Way of working to focus capacity, surface and address blockers, and achieve desired outcomes to continuously elevate tangible delivery of Chesapeake’s purpose to stakeholders.
 
The Director of Strategic Operations does not primarily lead through formal authority. Instead, this person must lead through influence, clarity, structure, trust, and disciplined follow-through. They can constructively challenge thinking, influence senior leaders, facilitate challenging prioritization discussions, and establish alignment across varying priorities. They must be able to inspire and motivate others, help leaders understand the “why” and “how” behind the Growth System, and create the conditions for teams to sustainably improve the business solving important, challenging problems together.
 
 
**Duties and Responsibilities:** 
Growth System Leadership
 

* Serve as the enterprise owner and steward of Chesapeake’s Growth System.
* Maintain fidelity to the 4DX operating model, including WIG selection, lead and lag measures, scoreboards, team syncs, accountability rhythms, and celebrations.
